ap4MethodReview.name: test_01_actual_consumers_keep_private_function_identity_and_enabled_checks
ap4MethodReview.review: Profiles the actual original consumers and their globals; checks both enabled hash-check arguments and the exact captured bytes entering the hash helpers. Only PLAN and PROFILE change in the private modules.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_02_each_public_call_uses_one_fresh_snapshot_and_initialization
ap4MethodReview.review: Observes one fresh snapshot, one initialization and one consumption per public call; repeated calls use distinct fresh helpers, modules and captured byte objects. No public-AP3-observe-then-reinitialize shortcut.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_03_report_matches_four_actual_captured_file_operations
ap4MethodReview.review: Wraps actual adapter methods and compares the four calls, ordering, returned values and byte identities with the report.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_04_actual_candidate_call_graph_and_consumption_use_no_io
ap4MethodReview.review: Profiles the two roots and reviewed pure-helper call graph; guards content, metadata, path-protocol and process I/O during consumption. It does not guard the entire AP2 verification/import phase.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_05_configuration_pathname_changes_after_capture_use_captured_bytes
ap4MethodReview.review: Actually replaces both configuration pathnames after capture, then checks that the original captured bytes are consumed. It does not enumerate every deletion, link or race variation.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_06_invalid_public_inputs_reject_before_helper_code
ap4MethodReview.review: Rejects malformed pins, wrong/mutable/subclass bytes, changed bytes and oversized inputs before helper/candidate progress.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_07_pinned_helper_drift_rejects_before_compilation
ap4MethodReview.review: Returns an inert changed helper through the read seam and proves rejection before compilation. This is a read-seam check, not a physical helper-file replacement fixture.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_08_private_captured_records_require_consistent_immutable_bytes
ap4MethodReview.review: Checks private record consistency for both artifacts, including exact bytes, path, bounds and blob. It does not independently confer AP2 provenance on caller-made records.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_09_private_adapters_are_narrow_frozen_snapshot_views
ap4MethodReview.review: Checks narrow frozen adapters, exact bytes, absent file/path fallback and ordinary assignment rejection. Python-private objects are not an adversarial sandbox.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_10_private_binding_and_blob_mismatches_reject_before_consumer_calls
ap4MethodReview.review: Rejects wrong project/function bindings and artifact constants before consumer attempts, including self-consistent changed record bytes that disagree with the original constant.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_11_real_consumers_reject_changed_read_bytes_with_truthful_progress
ap4MethodReview.review: Benign appended newlines reach the real consumer hash checks; plan/profile failures retain distinct attempted/completed lists and partial values. This is not exhaustive schema rejection coverage.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_12_profile_read_interruption_does_not_claim_profile_invocation
ap4MethodReview.review: Interrupts profile-byte acquisition and profiles actual calls: plan completion survives and checked_profile is neither entered nor reported attempted.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_13_earlier_reports_remain_frozen_preconsumer_observations
ap4MethodReview.review: Mutates later private observation/progress data and verifies the previously serialized AP3/AP2 reports remain unchanged with their earlier-stage scopes.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_14_private_helper_registrations_are_removed_for_all_outcomes
ap4MethodReview.review: Covers four enumerated ordinary outcomes: success, AP3 compile interruption, AP2 rejection and consumer-boundary interruption. It does not prove cleanup for every possible failure.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_15_public_observations_are_immutable_json_with_a_narrow_signature
ap4MethodReview.review: Checks the two-argument API, frozen canonical success bytes, copied success/rejection presentations and rejection of context/module/bundle/mode keywords.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_16_real_isolated_cli_preserves_checkout_and_creates_no_output
ap4MethodReview.review: Runs the real isolated CLI in a temporary Git fixture with inert ambient import files; checks refs, index, tracked bytes, clean status, protected outputs and no ambient bytecode.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_17_cli_requires_all_three_real_interpreter_flags
ap4MethodReview.review: Removes each required real interpreter flag separately and checks rejection before candidate progress.

ap4MethodReview.name: test_18_cli_requires_both_arguments_and_rejects_execution_options
ap4MethodReview.review: Checks wrong pin, missing required arguments and unsupported execution options; distinguishes structured rejection from argparse diagnostics.

workflow.gateScript:
set -euo pipefail
tool=_demo/Tools/AssemblyShadow/R03IR/D5Local
set +e
python3 -B "$tool/run_d5_local.py" \
  --mode execute \
  --approved-envelope "$RUNNER_TEMP/unapproved-d5b-envelope.json" \
  > "$RUNNER_TEMP/blocked-execution.json"
code=$?
set -e
test "$code" -eq 2

grep -q '"outputCreated": false' "$RUNNER_TEMP/blocked-execution.json"
test ! -e "$RUNNER_TEMP/unapproved-d5b-envelope.json"
cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/blocked-execution.json"
echo '{"schema":"R03D5BLocalAdmissionSourceHostV1","sourceTests":94,"approvedEnvelope":false,"localExecution":false,"unityOrPlayer":false,"R03Accepted":false,"result":"SourceOnlyDeniedLocalExecution"}'
